Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 5859 of 2023

Applicant :- Sarita @ Guriya And Another
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Satyendra Nath Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.

Heard Shri Satyendra Nath Mishra, learned counsel for the accused-applicants as well as learned counsel representing the State and perused the record.
This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicants namely Sarita @ Guriya and Saroj for grant of bail, in Case Crime No.104 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Gosainganj, District Sultanpur, during trial.
Learned counsel for the accused-applicants while pressing the bail application submits that the applicants have been falsely implicated in this case and they have not committed any offence as claimed by the prosecution.

It is further submitted that the applicants are the sister-in-laws of the deceased and since marriage of the deceased with the brother of the applicants, they were not having any affair of the deceased as Sarita @ Guriya And Another vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: they were living separately in the same house.
Having regard to all the facts and circumstances of the case, they could not be beneficiary of the dowry, which was allegedly being demanded.

It is also submitted that general allegation of demand of dowry and committing cruelty in lieu thereof has been levelled in the F.I.R. as well as in the statement of the prosecution witnesses against all the accused persons and no specific allegation has been levelled against the instant applicants.
The deceased had committed suicide.

The applicants, who were residing separately,
could not be fastened with liability to explain the circumstances, under which the deceased had committed suicide as the same could only be explained by the husband of the deceased.
Identically placed co-accused person namely Ram Kumar has been granted bail by a Coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 5.7.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.8275 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.8275 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: It is also submitted that the applicants are in jail in this case since 03.03.2023 and they are not having any criminal history.
Charge sheet in this case has already been filed and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail the applicants may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.

Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicants on the ground that the applicants are accused of committing an heinous offence and having regard to the material/evidence available against the applicants, they are not entitled to be released on bail, but could not controvert the other factual submissions made by learned counsel for the applicants.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that identically placed co-accused person namely Ram Kumar has been granted bail by a Coordinate Bench of this Court.

The role of the applicants is identical to co-accused Ram Kumar moreover they are ladies and it is vehemently submitted on behalf of the applicants that since the deceased had committed suicide, the applicants could not be fastened with any liability to explain the circumstances, under which the deceased had committed suicide as the same could only be explained by the husband of the deceased.
The role of the instant applicants is distinguishable from the role of the husband of the deceased.
The applicants are in jail in this case since 03.03.2023 and they are not having any criminal history.
Charge sheet in this case has already been filed.
The presence of the applicants could be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

Having regard to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicants have made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

Let the accused/applicants namely Sarita @ Guriya and Saroj involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on their furnishing personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicants shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.

sentences.text: (ii) The applicants shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicants shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
Identity, status and residence proof of the applicants and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression of this Court on the merits of the case.
